pages.text: Four native effects: $(thing)Lightfoot$() (higher jump, safe fall), $(thing)Glowmarked$() (the target glows), $(thing)Sporeblind$() (a spore-clouded slow), and $(thing)Rooted$() (heavy slow, no jump).
Brew each from an Awkward Potion + a native ingredient: $(br)Air Gel → Lightfoot$(br)Glow Pollen → Glowmarked$(br)Spore Sac (or Glowcap Spores) → Sporeblind$(br)Living Fiber → Rooted
